levels.R0: Recorded source, inputs and outputs with calculated hashes.
levels.R1: Seeded replay with an input-driven seed, algorithm/version and stream partition; CI must verify seed sensitivity.
levels.R2: Replay of an embedded external input snapshot with declared capabilities and parameters; CI must verify the snapshot and sensitivity contract.

replay.note: Website CI compares the replayed SVG byte-for-byte with this bundled figure; R1 requires seeded-randomness evidence.

figure_metadata.policy: The bundle generator normalizes the recorded SVG metadata to these calculated hashes; bundle manifest hashes are authoritative.

platform_policy.output: byte equality is verified only against the recorded figure in the CI replay configuration; this is not a cross-platform guarantee
platform_policy.numeric: cross-platform numerical comparison is not performed or claimed; before comparing, declare absolute and relative tolerances per metric with units, reference method, and applicable input domain; no universal epsilon is assumed

provenance.limits: R0 exact SVG replay is verified in website CI. Compiler effects are captured by the experimental conservative analyzer; host capture, seeded-randomness evidence for R1, external snapshots and complete R2/R3 guarantees remain pending.
